A tiny race against the seasons

TREETOP

from twig to treetop
Reach the treetop at 120 m before winter. The season bar is your clock, and your sap is your life.
Grow. Your branch never stops. Steer its tip with the mouse, touch, or arrow keys. Hold the mouse button, Space, or a second finger to surge: faster growth, faster drain. On a phone, hold the Surge button.
Sunlight becomes sap: each golden sun you gather is +22 on the green SAP bar, and that bar drains as you grow. No sap, no growth.
Rain is a drink on the way up. Catch the drops.
Shade (the dark drifting canopies) drains you fast, wind bends you, and rival bark drinks your sap.
Endless Autumn is the forever climb: no treetop and no win, the forest just grows upward, the seasons keep turning, and every autumn your sap drains a little faster. It ends when you wither. How high can you get?
